rudy-bojorquez.text: Campaign site: "Supporting our local sheriff means supporting proactive policing, community outreach programs, and partnerships that focus on prevention as much as enforcement," citing "crime down 40%."

source.title: Public Safety - Re-Elect Rudy Bojorquez 2026 (campaign site)

rudy-bojorquez.text: Endorsed by the Association for Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs (ALADS), which cited his "support of deputy sheriffs and support of a fair bargaining process for ALADS members."

source.title: Public Safety - Re-Elect Rudy Bojorquez 2026 (campaign site)

rudy-bojorquez.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party - Endorsed Candidates, Nov. 3, 2026 General Election

rudy-bojorquez.text: Endorsed by Rep. Gil Cisneros, LA County Supervisor Hilda Solis and Assemblymember Lisa Calderon.

kimberly-kim-valencia.text: Campaign blog: stressed "investing in high-quality camera systems" to identify suspects and deter crime, and said that although crime is trending down, seniors still feel unsafe: "Public safety is not only about data. It is also about perception, confidence, and trust."

source.title: Coffee with a Deputy 2025 & 2026 - Kimberly Kim Valencia for South El Monte Council 2026 (campaign site)

kimberly-kim-valencia.text: "Our city has been tainted by corruption and extortion in the past. It is time to believe in ethical leadership." Says she wants a city where "small businesses can grow."

source.title: Kimberly Kim Valencia for South El Monte Council 2026 (campaign site)
